empty.heading: Your application starts here
empty.body: Answer at your own pace. Everything you enter is saved automatically on this device — leave any time and pick up where you stopped.

storage.heading: We couldn't save your changes
storage.body: Your browser storage may be full or unavailable, so your latest edits aren't saved yet. Free up space, then tap Retry.

quotaWarning: Storage is running low. Documents are compressed before saving, but if storage fills up, new uploads won't be saved. Remove old files or free up device space.

clearDraft.title: Clear everything you've entered?
clearDraft.body: This permanently deletes your saved answers and documents from this device. You'll start from the beginning.

notice.translationPending: {{language}} translation is coming soon. The app is showing English for now.
